actorFeatureScaling._comment: All fields are in [0,1]. Total and active body-part counts divide by maxBodyParts; positions divide by roomSize-1; roomIndex divides by maxRooms-1; storedEnergy/storeCapacity and room energy divide by maxRoomEnergy; fatigue divides by 10; ticksToLive divides by 1500. The original body and its currently usable subset are both recoverable.

reward._comment: Only harvested energy and controller progress enter reward. Delivery, construction, claims, spawning, and storage flows remain diagnostics and qualification gates because gross progress signals can be gamed.

teacher._comment: The International is configured for this observation ABI. Stock radii (remotes 5, unbounded scouting) grow a 7-to-15-room colony, so a labelled tick commands creeps in rooms no room slot can hold: at 20,000 ticks a staked room was dropped on 74-86% of ticks across three seeds and live creeps peaked at 111-122 against 64 creep slots. Collection asserts the loaded bundle's constants equal these values; changing either changes what the corpus means and must bump teacherAbi.

nextLat._comment: Action-conditioned one-step latent dynamics. Future encodings and critic teacher logits are detached; terminal, reset, and rollout-tail transitions are excluded.

value._comment: HL-Gauss categorical critic on a signed-log support. The 409 bins center exactly on zero and +/-1e9 expected-return anchors, with four tail-margin bins per side. The margin makes the hard representable target bound approximately +/-1.594e9; targets beyond it fail instead of clamping. Critic gradients clip at 0.5 and values are never clipped.

ppo._targetKlNote: KL is diagnostic only. PPO always completes the configured three epochs; clipping, not a KL anchor, defines the policy update.
ppo._vapoNote: VAPO (arXiv 2504.05118). Decoupled GAE: the critic target uses gaeLambdaCritic=1 (the discounted Monte-Carlo return over the segment), while policy advantages use a per-transition lambda = 1 - 1/(gaeLambdaPolicyAlpha * l) from eq. 5, with l the length of the segment that transition sits in. At l=2048 that is lambda=0.99902, a credit window of about 677 ticks against 18 under the previous single lambda=0.95. selfImitationCoef weights the eq. 9 positive-example NLL over the top 1-selfImitationQuantile of each rollout's per-environment segment returns, selected by rank so ties cannot invert the set. groupStartsPerState environments per lane share one drawn start state.
ppo._extendNote: rolloutSteps equals maxRolloutSteps, so extendSteps and extendRateThreshold are inert: the adaptive one-shot extension only fires when the base horizon is below the cap. They stay configured for runs that set a shorter --steps.
ppo._budgetNote: minibatch and rolloutSteps are measured ceilings on this host, not preferences. A complete update at observation-ABI capacity (4 live rooms, 100 actor rows, 128 candidates) peaks at 16.5 GiB allocated for minibatch 1024 and OOMs at 1536 on a 31.4 GiB device; HostRolloutBuffer needs 15.8 GiB for 24x2048 at four live rooms and 31.5 GiB at 24x4096, which this host does not have free. Raise either only with a fresh measurement.
